description: Cache public ConverterAll AI pages and assets with origin TTLs
expression: (http.host eq "converterallai.com" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") and http.request.uri.path ne "/api" and http.request.uri.path ne "/healthz" and not any(http.request.headers["authorization"][*] ne ""))
